title: Bakhtiyar Khalji advances east after Bihar campaigns
detail: After consolidating military momentum in Bihar, Bakhtiyar moved toward Bengal through less-guarded routes, preparing a rapid strike on the Sena capital zone.

title: Nadia is captured and Lakshmana Sena retreats
detail: Bakhtiyar Khalji's surprise assault took Nadia, and the Sena ruler Lakshmana Sena withdrew, signaling the collapse of Sena control over the main western political center.

title: Power center shifts toward Lakhnauti/Gaur
detail: Following the conquest, governance and military consolidation were organized around northwestern Bengal centers, accelerating political restructuring.

title: Transition from Sena-era order to new ruling formations
detail: The conquest opened a long transition that eventually produced wider sultanate-era sovereignty and transformed Bengal's political institutions.
